claims.statement: Within the finite asymmetric rooted branch-forest family defined in REPORT.md, for 3<=p<=7 and |T|=2p+2, the complete favorable-leaf sum is nonpositive in every eligible generated tree; no eligible tree has a positive selected summand.
claims.scope: Only the stated rooted family: support-rooted trees with a distinguished support-leaf, total branch order 2p, at least two branch components of at least two distinct rooted isomorphism types, and the exact primary eligibility guards.
claims.reason: An exact deterministic finite enumeration found only negative complete sums in its eligible rows. The enumeration omits other shell trees and gives no proof beyond its explicit family and orders.

limitations: This is a bounded computation, not a proof or refutation of the registered first-shell assertion.
The family excludes symmetric rooted branch products, products with fewer than two branch components, and all p outside 3 through 7.
Counts are rooted family counts and may include repeated unrooted isomorphism types.
No positive selected local term was found, so the search does not test compensation for such a term in this family.
